note: UI-only automation triggers. Brevo's public API does not expose workflow CRUD; this catalog records the triggers, their plan requirements and whether an API/webhook path can feed them. Verified live: only the custom-event ingestion path (POST /events).

triggers.name: Contact added to list
triggers.description: Enters when a contact is added to a specific list.

triggers.name: Contact removed from list
triggers.description: Enters when a contact is removed from a specific list.

triggers.name: Contact matches custom filters
triggers.description: Enters when a contact matches filters defined in the trigger, checked periodically.

triggers.name: Contact is in a segment
triggers.description: Enters when a contact meets a saved segment, checked periodically.

triggers.name: Anniversary
triggers.description: Enters based on a date attribute (birthday/anniversary), ignoring the year.

triggers.name: Contact added manually
triggers.description: Manual enrollment from the Contacts page or contact detail.

triggers.name: Form submitted
triggers.description: Enters when a contact submits a Brevo form (subscription, unsubscription or profile update).

triggers.name: Email opened
triggers.description: Enters when a contact opens an email sent from Brevo; Apple MPP contacts are excluded.

triggers.name: Link clicked in an email
triggers.description: Enters when a contact clicks a link in an email sent from Brevo.

triggers.name: Unsubscribed from email list
triggers.description: Enters when a contact unsubscribes from an email list.

triggers.name: Cart updated
triggers.description: Enters when a product is added to the cart; requires the Brevo tracker.

triggers.name: Cart deleted
triggers.description: Enters when a product is removed from the cart; requires the Brevo tracker.

triggers.name: Order created
triggers.description: Enters when a purchase is made; requires the Brevo tracker.

triggers.name: Sales email clicked
triggers.description: Enters when a contact clicks a link in an email sent from a mailbox.

triggers.name: Sales email opened
triggers.description: Enters when a contact opens an email sent from a mailbox.

triggers.name: Conversation ended
triggers.description: Enters when a conversation ends.

triggers.name: Conversation started
triggers.description: Enters when a contact starts a conversation via email, chat or socials.

triggers.name: Message received
triggers.description: Enters when a contact sends a message via email, chat or social media.

triggers.name: Deal created
triggers.description: Enters when a deal associated with the contact is created.

triggers.name: Deal stage updated
triggers.description: Enters when the stage of an associated deal changes.

triggers.name: Task completed
triggers.description: Enters when an associated task is marked done.

triggers.name: Meeting booked
triggers.description: Enters when a contact books a meeting.

triggers.name: Meeting started
triggers.description: Enters when a contact joins a meeting.

triggers.name: Meeting canceled
triggers.description: Enters when a contact cancels a meeting.

triggers.name: Balance minimum value reached
triggers.description: Enters when a loyalty balance reaches its minimum limit.

triggers.name: Balance maximum value reached
triggers.description: Enters when a loyalty balance reaches its maximum limit.

triggers.name: Balance value updated
triggers.description: Enters when a loyalty balance is earned or redeemed.

triggers.name: Balance value expired
triggers.description: Enters when part of a loyalty balance expires.

triggers.name: Voucher created
triggers.description: Enters when a voucher is assigned to a contact.

triggers.name: Voucher redeemed
triggers.description: Enters when a contact redeems a voucher.

triggers.name: Voucher expired
triggers.description: Enters when a voucher expires.

triggers.name: Voucher revoked
triggers.description: Enters when a voucher is revoked.

triggers.name: Membership created
triggers.description: Enters when a contact subscribes to a loyalty program.

triggers.name: Membership year anniversary
triggers.description: Enters on the yearly anniversary of a loyalty membership.

triggers.name: Membership revoked
triggers.description: Enters when a contact leaves or is deleted from a loyalty program.

triggers.name: Tier association updated
triggers.description: Enters when a contact's loyalty tier changes.

triggers.name: Call finished
triggers.description: Enters when a call ends.

triggers.name: Payment request created
triggers.description: Enters when a payment request is created for a contact.

triggers.name: Payment request reminder sent
triggers.description: Enters when a payment request reminder is sent.

triggers.name: Payment done
triggers.description: Enters when a contact pays via a payment link or request.

triggers.name: Session started
triggers.description: Enters when a contact opens the website/app for the first time or after 30 minutes of inactivity.

triggers.name: Push notification clicked
triggers.description: Enters when a contact clicks a push notification.

triggers.name: Subscribed to push notifications
triggers.description: Enters when a contact subscribes to push notifications.

triggers.name: Unsubscribed from push notifications
triggers.description: Enters when a contact unsubscribes from push notifications.

triggers.name: Pass installed
triggers.description: Enters when a contact installs a wallet pass.

triggers.name: Pass downloaded
triggers.description: Enters when a contact downloads a wallet pass.

triggers.name: Optin updated
triggers.description: Enters when a pass is installed or deleted.

triggers.name: Status changed (pass owner)
triggers.description: Enters when a pass owner status changes.

triggers.name: Enrolled
triggers.description: Enters when a contact installs their first pass.

triggers.name: Pass status changed
triggers.description: Enters when a wallet pass is used, expired or canceled.

triggers.name: Anonymized
triggers.description: Enters when a contact is anonymized.

triggers.name: Redeem failed
triggers.description: Enters when a wallet redemption fails.

triggers.name: Redeem success
triggers.description: Enters when a wallet redemption succeeds.

triggers.name: Counter value changed
triggers.description: Enters when a counter linked to the profile changes.

triggers.name: Subscriber deactivated
triggers.description: Enters when a web-push subscriber is no longer reachable.

triggers.name: Subscriber refreshed
triggers.description: Enters when a browser refreshes push subscription details.

triggers.name: Webpush delivered
triggers.description: Enters when a web push notification is delivered.

triggers.name: Webpush clicked
triggers.description: Enters when a web push notification is clicked.

triggers.name: Webpush closed
triggers.description: Enters when a web push notification is closed.

triggers.name: Subscriber added
triggers.description: Enters when a contact subscribes and is added to contacts.

triggers.name: Webpage visited
triggers.description: Enters when a contact visits a tracked page.

triggers.name: WhatsApp reply received
triggers.description: Enters when a contact replies to a WhatsApp campaign.

triggers.name: Custom event
triggers.description: Enters when a tracked custom event occurs for a contact.

triggers.name: Based on a date attribute
triggers.description: Enters based on a date attribute on a custom object record.

triggers.name: [Record] created
triggers.description: Enters when a custom object record is created.

triggers.name: [Record] updated
triggers.description: Enters when a custom object record attribute is updated; associations do not count.
